pick.name: Cloudflare Workers (+ Durable Objects)
pick.what: TypeScript/Python APIs and remote MCP servers at the edge
pick.why: Free commercial tier, no cold starts, official remote-MCP template (Streamable HTTP) + Workers OAuth Provider for MCP auth
pick.free_limits: 100k req/day, 10 ms CPU/invocation, 50 subrequests, 128 MB; Durable Objects free: 100k req/day, 13,000 GB-s/day, SQLite only; Paid $5/mo

alts.name: Google Cloud Run
alts.why: Best free option for Python/FastAPI, long requests or anything that breaks the Workers runtime
alts.free_limits: Request-based: 2M requests, 180,000 vCPU-s, 360,000 GiB-s per month (us-central1 basis; via Google locale pages, main page fetch truncated); needs billing account/card

alts.name: Railway Hobby
alts.what: PaaS for containers, workers and DBs
alts.why: Pay-later pick: simplest container DX at $5/mo
alts.free_limits: Free: $1/mo credit, NO custom domains, 1 project/3 services; Hobby $5/mo incl. $5 usage, 2 custom domains, 50 services

candidates.name: Cloudflare Workers
candidates.verdict: PICK: free + commercial, edge, first-class MCP template

candidates.name: Google Cloud Run
candidates.verdict: Alt: best free container runtime; card required

candidates.name: Railway Hobby
candidates.verdict: Alt: $5/mo, nicest DX, free tier has no custom domains

candidates.name: Render Free
candidates.verdict: Rejected for prod: docs say 'Do not use them for production', spin-down after 15 min, SMTP blocked

candidates.name: Fly.io
candidates.verdict: No free tier for new orgs (2h/7-day trial); $2.19/mo for 256 MB is cheap pay-later

candidates.name: Koyeb
candidates.verdict: Rejected: joining Mistral AI (announced 2026-02-17); new users can only sign up for paid plans

candidates.name: Deno Deploy / Netlify Functions
candidates.verdict: Viable but smaller ecosystems for MCP/agents than Workers

decision: Workers is the default for TS APIs and MCP servers because the free tier is commercial-OK and Cloudflare ships the reference remote-MCP template with OAuth. Switch a service to Cloud Run when it needs >10 ms CPU on Free, native Python libs, long jobs or a Dockerfile; pay Workers $5/mo first if the only problem is CPU.
details: Workers Free 10 ms CPU can be blown by password hashing (scrypt) or heavy SSR; prefer OAuth/magic-link/passkeys or move to Workers Paid. Koyeb free-tier end is a 2026 cut.

verify.note: Limits confirmed: 50 subrequests, 128 MB, DO free 100k req/day + 13,000 GB-s/day (+5 GB SQLite storage). Remote MCP template command matches the guide exactly (createMcpHandler, Streamable HTTP, Workers OAuth Provider). Koyeb note confirmed: koyeb.com/pricing lists no free compute tier and carries a 'Koyeb is joining Mistral AI' banner (TechCrunch 2026-02-17 on the acquisition).
